items.title: Wilson "Chembo" Corniel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: I got the chance to perform with him too, with the group, but he wasn’t there, but the piano player was the leader. Me and Victor. Victor got me the gig. We did a gig with his band.

ctx.x: Right. You’d find his, like my parents would have had his LPs.

Right. That’s an LP, right? Xavier Cugat. I got the chance to perform with him too, with the group, but he wasn’t there, but the piano player was the leader. Me and Victor. Victor got me the gig. We did a gig with his band. But you see so now we’re starting to divide this thing up. Now for instance, big band for a percussionist, I’m a conga player, I’m expecting a bongo player, you’re going to see tonight, and a timbale player. That’s the full rhythm section of a big band. When you play cojunto, cojunto is only…
Oh sort of like a jazz tune, you’ve got the head at the beginning and at the end.
